title.zh: Codex 团队称容量报错可能已被修好
title.en: Codex team says capacity errors may be fixed (claim, not independently measured)

summary.zh: Codex 相关账号 Tibo 称团队可能已经修好长期困扰用户的「model at capacity」报错，并附上 2026-10-15 至 11-12（UTC）的折线图：日活用户中至少有一轮以容量报错结束的占比，从约 6.82% 降到 0.085%。必须保留「might have actually fixed」的不确定语气；统计只到 11 月 12 日，不是独立复测，也不是已确认写入官方变更日志的彻底修复。
summary.en: A Codex-adjacent account, Tibo, said the team might have fixed the long-running model-at-capacity errors, and attached a chart for 2026-10-15 through 11-12 (UTC): the share of daily active users with at least one turn ending in a capacity error fell from about 6.82% to 0.085%. Keep the uncertain wording. The chart stops on 12 November. It is not an independent retest, and it is not a confirmed changelog entry for a complete fix.

why.zh: 容量报错是近期高频痛点，但这是团队表态，不是已核实的修复声明。
why.en: Capacity errors have been a frequent pain point, but this is a team claim, not a verified fix.

notes.zh: 团队称可能已修好；本页未独立测量。
notes.en: The team said it might be fixed. This page did not measure it.
